required_documents.name: SF424 (R&R) Cover Form
required_documents.details: Standard federal application cover page including applicant organization UEI, contact information, and proposed project dates.

required_documents.name: Project Summary / Abstract
required_documents.details: Succinct summary of the proposed project, self-contained, no confidential information. Maximum 30 lines of text.
required_documents.source: PA-27-100-Revised-Full-Announcement.html Section IV.2 SF424(R&R) Other Project Information

required_documents.name: Project Narrative (Relevance Statement)
required_documents.details: Two or three sentences describing the relevance of this research to public health.
required_documents.source: PA-27-100-Revised-Full-Announcement.html Section IV.2 SF424(R&R) Other Project Information

required_documents.name: Facilities & Other Resources and Equipment
required_documents.details: Description of scientific facilities, laboratory space, clinical resources, and major equipment available to the small business.
required_documents.source: PA-27-100-Revised-Full-Announcement.html Section IV.2 SF424(R&R) Other Project Information

required_documents.name: R&R Senior/Key Person Profile (Expanded)
required_documents.details: Biographical sketches for PD/PI and senior key personnel (max 5 pages each). The eRA Commons username must be entered in the Credential field.
required_documents.source: PA-27-100-Revised-Full-Announcement.html Section IV.2 Senior/Key Person Profile

required_documents.name: R&R Budget and Budget Justification
required_documents.details: Detailed line-item budget for direct and indirect costs with an itemized budget justification narrative.

required_documents.name: Specific Aims
required_documents.details: One page outlining goals and hypotheses of proposed R&D project.
required_documents.source: PA-27-100-Revised-Full-Announcement.html Section IV.2 PHS 398 Research Plan

required_documents.name: Research Strategy
required_documents.details: Detailed description of Significance, Innovation, and Approach. Page limit: 6 pages for Phase I; 12 pages for Phase II, Fast-Track, and Direct-to-Phase II.

required_documents.name: Commercialization Plan
required_documents.details: Required for Phase II, Direct to Phase II, and Fast-Track applications. Maximum 12 pages covering market need, customer validation, intellectual property, and financing.
required_documents.source: PA-27-100-Revised-Full-Announcement.html Section IV.2 PHS 398 Research Plan

required_documents.name: Letters of Support
required_documents.details: Letters from consultants, clinical collaborators, potential commercial partners, or investors demonstrating support.
required_documents.source: PA-27-100-Revised-Full-Announcement.html Section IV.2 PHS 398 Research Plan

required_documents.name: SAM.gov, Grants.gov, eRA Commons, and SBIR.gov Registrations
required_documents.details: Small business must maintain active registrations with SAM.gov (UEI), Grants.gov, eRA Commons, and register on SBIR.gov to obtain an SBC Control ID.

deadlines.when: September 5, 2026, 5:00 p.m. local time of applicant organization
January 5, 2027, 5:00 p.m. local time of applicant organization
April 5, 2027, 5:00 p.m. local time of applicant organization

eligibility.summary: For-profit United States small business concerns (SBCs) with 500 or fewer employees. Primary employment of the PD/PI must be with the small business at the time of award and during the conduct of the project. North Carolina biotechnology, healthcare, and software small businesses are eligible.

cost_share.details: This NOFO does not require cost sharing as defined in the NIH Grants Policy Statement.

submission_limits: Applicant organizations may submit more than one application, provided each application is scientifically distinct.
important_notes: Failure to register in eRA Commons and include a valid PD/PI Commons ID in the credential field will prevent submission.
For Phase I, Research Strategy must not exceed 6 pages; for Phase II/Direct Phase II, max 12 pages. Over-length pages are not reviewed.
The primary employment of the PD/PI must be with the small business at the time of award and for the project duration (over 50% time).
